data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word ‘mosheh’ meaning ‘drawn out’ or ‘saved’. This name is associated with the biblical figure Moses, who was saved from the Nile River as a baby and later led the Israelites out of Egypt. The name Moishe carries the meaning “Saved from water” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Moishe usually hope their child will grow to embody saved from water and live with faith, good character and purpose.

He is best known for leading the Israelites out of bondage in Egypt and receiving the Ten Commandments directly from God on Mount Sinai. This name can serve as a reminder of resilience, leadership, and faith in God’s guidance.
